Why Ignoring Social Media Could Be the Biggest Mistake for Your Business

24 January 2025·Impulse Digital

Introduction

Over the years, social media has evolved from just a source of entertainment to now a necessity in the global marketing world. Every business, be it small or big, requires “Social Media Marketing” to uphold its brand in the competitive market.  

Your social media page says a lot about your work in the market be it your organizational achievements, creating an image, displaying work culture, office, team bonding activities, creating awareness about your brand in the widespread market attracting possible candidates & clients and so much more. Due to these businesses heavily invest and focus on social media marketing now! Therefore, not investing time and resources in social media management or strategy will hinder your growth subsequently.  

However, before you get started on social media marketing, 

Here are Things You Need to Focus on:

1. Consider the Appropriate Platform:

Every platform has a different audience base. You can choose the relevant platform for your brand based on segmentations like demographic, age group, geographical, etc. Focus on the platform most used by your target audience to hold a strong grip on connecting with your audience.  

2. Understand your Target Audience:

It’s important to understand what your relevant audience need from you to align them with your brand’s next move. This helps us follow strategic planning to yield good results.  

3. Formulate a Strategy:

Formulate a strategy based on how you plan to engage your target audience, type of content you plan to post, social media goals like engagement, building brand reputation, brand awareness, conversion goals, generate leads, etc.  

4. Analyze Content Performance:

Always monitor your results, “efforts put at the wrong strategy will waste time and effort”.  Analyzing the performance builds the gap between what you want from your brand to what it truly needs! Besides it is always a good option to redirect or alter your brand plans based on performance results, taking a better understanding of what works for your brand.  

5. Managing your Social Media Page Effectively:

Managing your social media platform effectively is the key. Consistent posting, deciding the type of content, creativity, designing, copies & captions for the post-everything can be smoothly managed by a trusted Digital marketing agency. Hiring an agency will help to have a dedicated and focused team that works on your brand goals.  

Also Read: How to Craft Social Media Videos That Capture Attention and Drive Engagement

Here’s Why Avoiding Social Media Can Affect your Business Growth:

  • Expanding Reach: Social media has billions of users actively using it, which helps visibility and increases the possibility of reaching out beyond geographical limitations. Content created based on recent events, or market trends helps elevate your visibility thereby making your brand presence even better.  
  • Cost-effective marketing: Social media is by far the most easily affordable tool for marketing. Being widely available and creating a vast impact on consumers directly. Compared to traditional social media it’s relatively more widely available, cost-effective, easy to use, and is the center of attraction due to its on-going popularity. 
  • Useful for new businesses/startups: For startups or mid-level emerging businesses social media is a relatively more secure and affordable option for advertising and marketing. A strategic way of handling social media will lead to both brand awareness and attract clients.  
  • Chance to go viral: “Content is your brand’s power”. Any post could go viral making your brand thrive in the business world, getting recognition, and becoming the talk of the town. With keen attention to social media, joining trends and creative ideas connecting them to your brand will garner the best possible results.  

Eg: The viral Dubai chocolate, fix dessert chocolatier got popular through a TikTok video that got viral and there we go. Everyone has been talking about it, making content on it, recreating it offering sales, recognition, popularity and high demand for the product.  

  • Directly engaging with audience: Offers an opportunity to connect and directly communicate with your audience. A variety of opportunities like live, contests and polls, product or service launch content, and engaging sources of communication offer a more transparent, communicative and creative way to connect and understand your audience better.  
  • Building an image: Your social media builds your image it helps customers/ visitors understand what your brand is all about in a simple creative way through posts, reels, stories it also helps brand visibility by boosting your overall presence across new audience and gaining recognition.

Conclusion:

Being a convenient and smart marketing tool for advertising and marketing, social media also needs to be well maintained and handled efficiently.  

If you’re new to this, we recommend getting associated with a Digital marketing agency, to improve and upskill your marketing efforts. Hiring an agency will help you get your mind off it and focus on other business needs, while your agency experts carefully strategize and assist with their marketing skills.
